# Hacker News Public Reads

> Read-only, normalized public-data reads of Hacker News stories, items, users, and search exposed through the ReplyNodes Hacker News public-read service: front-page and category feeds, single-item fetch with bounded comment threading, user profiles, and term search. GET-only read capabilities with Bearer workspace-key or x402 v2 negotiation at the gateway, bounded pages, normalized v1 payloads, and transparent errors plus an explicit unsupported-capability matrix.

Base URL: deployment-specific. The supported public gateway base URL is https://api.replynodes.com. Use this deployment base unless your workspace is explicitly issued another HTTPS gateway URL; never use localhost.

## Surface status

- The nine documented read operations have stable public contracts with bounded requests and normalized v1 responses.
- Route paths in this catalog are stable capability identifiers used for agent tool bindings; public gateway exposure for this platform is issued to your workspace at onboarding and must not be assumed reachable anywhere else.
- No availability, uptime, latency, or success-rate figure is claimed anywhere in this package; example payloads are illustrative fixtures, not captured responses from the live gateway.
- A 402 payment-required response is the x402 v2 requirements advertisement, not evidence of settlement or successful paid access.

## Endpoints

- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_top` - Front-page Hacker News stories (capability `get_stories_top`).
  - Query parameter `limit` (optional): Page size bound; defaults to 20 and is clamped to at most 50 client-side.
  - Query parameter `page` (optional): 1-indexed page number; mutually exclusive with `cursor`.
  - Query parameter `cursor` (optional): Opaque continuation token from a prior `meta.next_cursor`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_new` - Newest Hacker News stories (capability `get_stories_new`).
  - Same query parameters as `stories_top`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_best` - Best Hacker News stories (capability `get_stories_best`).
  - Same query parameters as `stories_top`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_ask` - Ask HN feed (capability `get_stories_ask`).
  - Same query parameters as `stories_top`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_show` - Show HN feed (capability `get_stories_show`).
  - Same query parameters as `stories_top`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/stories_job` - Jobs feed (capability `get_stories_job`).
  - Same query parameters as `stories_top`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/item/{id}` - One Hacker News item with bounded comment thread (capability `get_item`).
  - Path parameter `id` (required): Numeric Hacker News item id.
  - Query parameter `depth` (optional): Max comment depth to inline; defaults to 3 and is clamped at 8 client-side. Nested comments past the bound are dropped and reported in `meta.missing_fields`.
- `GET /v1/hackernews/user/{handle}` - Public Hacker News user profile (capability `get_user`).
  - Path parameter `handle` (required): Hacker News username (case-sensitive).
- `GET /v1/hackernews/search` - Hacker News term search (capability `search`).
  - Query parameter `q` (required): Free-text search query; required and never empty after trimming.
  - Query parameter `tags` (optional): Comma-separated tag filters (e.g. `story`, `comment`, `poll`, `show_hn`, `ask_hn`, `front_page`).
  - Query parameter `limit` (optional): Page size bound; defaults to 20 and is clamped to at most 50 client-side.
  - Query parameter `page` (optional): 1-indexed page number; mutually exclusive with `cursor`.
  - Query parameter `cursor` (optional): Opaque continuation token from a prior `meta.next_cursor`.

## Auth (two truthful paths)

1. Bearer workspace key: `Authorization: Bearer ***` at the gateway; prepaid credits are debited synchronously before the upstream read runs and a failed request is never charged.
2. x402 v2 negotiation: omit auth, receive HTTP 402 with a machine-readable `accepts` block (scheme, network, asset, exact amount); an x402 v2 client signs and re-issues the same call with `X-PAYMENT`.

A 402 response is the requirements advertisement, not evidence of settlement or successful paid access.

## Bounded pages

- Feeds (`stories_*`) and `search` return one bounded page (default 20, max 50).
- `meta.next_cursor` is `null` on the last page; otherwise it is an opaque string the client passes back as `?cursor=...` for the next page.
- `get_item` and `get_user` never return a continuation token.
- Comment threads are inlined up to a bounded depth; deeper comments are dropped and reported in `meta.missing_fields` (never invented).

## What this package does not claim

- No registry or marketplace listing, download statistics, ratings, or community metrics exist for it.
- No live availability, latency, uptime, or success-rate figures are asserted anywhere.
- No official platform partnership, endorsement, license grant, or data-sharing arrangement with the upstream platform is claimed.
- No submit, vote, comment, favorite, login, account, or other write/authenticated capability exists or is advertised.
- No credentials, session cookies, user identifiers, or fallback claims are included in this package.
